n_justification: 840 hourly clearing prices; dispersion matching is a one-moment fit with dispersion monotone in lambda on this game (unit-tested), so the inverse is well-posed GIVEN the stylised model.
notes: CONDITIONAL pipeline: identification rests entirely on the stylised 2-generator uniform-price model (cost = observed price floor, offers = observed quantile ladder). Verdict on July-2026 SP15: MODEL REJECTED — the stylised duopoly's dispersion ceiling (max over all lambda) sits well below the observed spike-driven price std, so no lambda is reported. Scarcity spikes exceed what 2-agent undercutting can generate; a richer supply model is the follow-up. See F-0008/F-0009 for what IS claimed from this data.
